summary.text: Catherine Cullen is a Republican state representative from New Mexico who has represented House District 57 since January 1, 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a real estate broker and previously served on the Rio Rancho Public Schools school board.

paragraphs.text: Cullen's career experience includes working as a real estate broker.

She has served on the Rio Rancho Public School Board of Education, representing District 5, and on the UNM Parent Association, and she completed Leadership New Mexico's Local Government Program and Leadership Sandoval County.
